consumables.name: Tonic
consumables.text: Restores 25% HP.

consumables.name: Strong Tonic
consumables.text: Restores 50% HP.

consumables.name: Vital Draught
consumables.text: Restores all HP.

consumables.name: Bone Salve
consumables.text: Durability +30% to the most battered location.

consumables.name: Whole Salve
consumables.text: Durability +20% to every location.

consumables.name: Antidote
consumables.text: Cures every physical ailment.

consumables.name: Clarity Draught
consumables.text: Cures every mental ailment.

consumables.name: Wine
consumables.text: Sanity +10%; Accuracy −5% for 100 ticks (none for the Fond of Wine).

consumables.name: Saint's Candle
consumables.text: Sanity +25% to everyone in a 3×3.

consumables.name: Smelling Salts
consumables.text: Revives a Down Scion at 10% HP.

consumables.name: Oil of Haste
consumables.text: Haste for 200 ticks.

consumables.name: Firebomb
consumables.text: Lobbed: fire in a 3×3, scaled by Acuity.

consumables.name: Frost Flask
consumables.text: Lobbed: water in a 3×3, scaled by Acuity.

consumables.name: Shock Jar
consumables.text: Lobbed: wind in a 3×3, scaled by Acuity.

consumables.name: Caltrops
consumables.text: Scattered on an enemy cell: whoever stands there is Slowed.

consumables.name: Net
consumables.text: Thrown over an enemy: it cannot Move.

consumables.name: Scroll
consumables.text: One cast of a Magus or Soothsayer spell at charge 0; the scroll names its spell when found.

consumables.name: Component Pouch
consumables.text: A Tinkerer picks 2 Components now.

consumables.name: Tarot Token
consumables.text: Draws a new Tarot for one Scion, once per Scion.

consumables.name: Passive Draught
consumables.text: Passive budget +1 for one expedition.

consumables.name: Widow's Tea
consumables.text: At a Camp: Sanity +20%, then Sleep for the next battle's first 100 ticks.

consumables.name: Grave Dust
consumables.text: Undead in a 3×3 flee for 2 turns; a boss loses 30 Readiness instead.

consumables.name: Ember Oil
consumables.text: The weapon gains a fire edge for one battle.

consumables.name: Brine
consumables.text: The weapon gains a water edge for one battle.

consumables.name: Stormwax
consumables.text: The weapon gains a wind edge for one battle.

consumables.name: Blackroot Chew
consumables.text: Durability +5% to every location each turn for 3 turns; Sanity −5.

consumables.name: Pilgrim's Bread
consumables.text: At a Camp: the whole party to full HP. Useless in battle.

consumables.name: Hangman's Rope
consumables.text: An enemy is Rooted for 3 turns; then the rope is lost.

consumables.name: Mirror Shard
consumables.text: Reflects the next spell aimed at its user, once.

consumables.name: Saint's Tooth
consumables.text: Carried: once, a Mortal wound becomes a severing instead. Spent when it saves a life.

consumables.name: Lantern
consumables.text: Lit before a node: it cannot Ambush the party; an Encounter is a Surprise instead.

consumables.name: Signal Flare
consumables.text: On a Rescue card: a Lost Scion joins the party at the next node.

consumables.name: Mourning Veil
consumables.text: One Scion is Sanity-proof for a battle; Sanity −10% after.

consumables.name: Smuggler's Flask
consumables.text: At a Camp: a Scion counts as Rested, full Durability for the next battle; Sanity −5.

consumables.name: Hollow Ivory Dust
consumables.text: Constructs and undead in a cross are Stunned for a turn.

consumables.name: Dice of the Marches
consumables.text: Carried: reroll one injury roll before seeing the table; one use.

consumables.name: Thief's Candle
consumables.text: Reveals every hazard on the enemy grid; a Lurker loses its free turn.

consumables.name: Bottled Chorus
consumables.text: A Minstrel song plays for 2 turns without a Minstrel.

consumables.name: Oathwine
consumables.text: Every Scion of one House on the field deals +10% damage for the battle.
